title: Suppress redundant unreported-turn close notices in unbound or non-Engram sessions
outcome: Unbound adopted turns retain the truthful adoption notice without an extra close-time message repeating that nothing is reported; newly lost scope still has a visible explanation.
acceptance: No-Engram and no-claimed-binding producer-boundary tests assert no send and the exact intended transcript notice count.
A binding or configured scope lost after adoption still produces a visible unreported reason, published through the normal state/delta path.
The maintained full gate passes on the exact input.
